subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: Should OpenClaw accept GitHub Copilot Enterprise data-residency as a bundled provider auth/config surface with `COPILOT_GITHUB_DOMAIN` and deprecated provider-auth helpers after the env-switch reuse bug is fixed?
rationale: The PR adds useful enterprise support but changes provider auth behavior, config/env surface, and public SDK exports, which repository policy treats as owner/product-sensitive rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept After Repair
options.body: Fix the env-domain reuse bug, keep the additive tenant auth path, and proceed with owner review for the new surfaces.

options.title: Narrow The Surface
options.body: Keep tenant runtime routing but remove or reduce the new env/SDK surface until a maintainer-approved contract is documented.

options.title: Defer Bundled Support
options.body: Close or pause this PR and ask for a smaller plugin/ClawHub or owner-sponsored proposal if bundled GHE.com Copilot support is not wanted now.

recommendation.title: Accept After Repair
recommendation.body: Fix the env-domain reuse bug, keep the additive tenant auth path, and proceed with owner review for the new surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Copilot provider and SDK-surface history makes this the best available owner for the product/API acceptance call.
